summary: Audit P3 hardening verification (iteration 228). Ran secret scanner, unit lane (32 tests), and 9 live HTTP tests against the preview. All P3 items (P3-1 scanner, P3-2 admin-only diagnostics, P3-3 fail-open alert unit test, P3-4 bounded denied-count under 20 rapid unauth requests) and regression (scorecard R1..R8, execution-health owned+random, security headers on /api/health) pass. UI check: /bot-health as admin renders the data-testid='ai-latency-card' with provider data (HEALTHY).
critical_code_review_comments: secret_scan._suspicious templated-residue rule (scripts/secret_scan.py L79-86) correctly treats '${VAR}' and '{token}'-only strings as placeholders while a high-entropy base with a '{token}' sub-string still triggers 'high-entropy-credential-literal' — verified live.

diagnostic_routes.py fx_rates_view/ai_latency_view both call require_admin AFTER get_current_user — order is correct; 401 unauthenticated, 200 admin, 403 for non-admin (register endpoint not open on preview so non-admin was skipped; code path uses the same require_admin dependency as other admin endpoints which do return 403).
No destructive endpoints were invoked. 20 rapid unauth GET /api/accounts all returned 401, /api/health still 200 afterwards — confirms the bounded _flush_denied_counts path.
